entries.source: PANGERL, Goldenkron (=FRA II/37, Wien 1872) S. 58-59, 1315 II 02
entries.german:
Hermann ,episcopus Prysiriensis‘ beurkundet ebenfalls die in seiner und in Gegenwart genannter Personen vollzogene Güterschenkung des Herrn Bawor von Baworow an das Kloster Goldenkron.

Necessarium est, ut ea quae geruntur sub tempore, litterarum serie atque auctenticorum virorum attestationibus taliter roborentur, ne eadem a futurorum hominum memoria per oblivionis abusum aliqualiter inanescant. Ea consideratione nos frater Hermannus de ordine fratrum Praedicatorum miseratione divina episcopus Prýsiriensis 1 universis Christi fidelibus tenore praesentium evidentius protestamur, quod videlicet nobilis atque praeclarus vir dominus Bawarus de Bawarow venerabilibus viris abbati atque conventui de Sancta Corona contulit atque donavit pro remedio animae suae villas suas wlgariter dictas videlicet Zwýneitz cum curia sua eodem vocabulo nuncupata, Moýn, Xsydel cum nemore adiacente quod dicitur Zusný, Zaltitz, Zchýrnitz cum iure patronatus ecclesiae eiusdem villae, cum omnibus ad easdem villas pertinentibus scilicet montibus, vallibus, silvis, rivis, piscationibus, venationibus, aurifodinis, cum omni prorsus utilitate terrena et cum omni iure, quo ipse easdem possessiones atque villas possederat, praefato monasterio inperpetuum possidendas in praesentia nostri atque in praesentia nobilium atque honorabilium virorum, videlicet domini Wenzeslai militis atque burgravii in Rosenbberg atque domini Dýtmari militis dicti Kusner 2, domini Henrici et fratris ipsius Smýlonis de Clum 3; item domini Johannis purgravii in Poresink 4 et fratris eius Phýlippi, nec non et in praesentia aliorum plurimorum hominum fidedignorum praedicta bona voluntarie atque liberaliter resignavit. In cuius rei testimonium abbati et conventui praefati monasterii praesens auctenticum tradimus sigilli nostri munimine roboratum. Actum et datum anno domini millesimo CCC moXV o, in die purificationis beatae Mariae virginis gloriosae.
entries.english:
Hermann, Bishop of Prachatice, likewise certifies the property donation made by Lord Bawor of Baworow to Goldenkron Monastery in his presence and in the presence of the named persons.

It is necessary that things done in time be strengthened by written records and the attestation of trustworthy men, so that they do not grow somewhat empty through oblivion in the memory of future people. By this consideration we, Brother Hermann of the Order of Preachers, by divine mercy Bishop of Prachatice, more clearly testify to all faithful Christians through these presents, namely that the noble and illustrious man Lord Bawarus de Bawarow granted and donated for the remedy of his soul to the venerable abbot and convent of Holy Crown their villages commonly called, namely Zwýneitz with its court named by the same word, Moýn, Xsydel with the adjacent wood called Zusný, Zaltitz, Zchýrnitz with the right of patronage of the church of the same village, with all that pertains to the same villages, namely mountains, valleys, forests, streams, fisheries, hunts, gold mines, with every earthly utility and with every right by which he himself possessed the same possessions and villages, to be held in perpetuity by the aforesaid monastery in our presence and in the presence of noble and honorable men, namely Lord Wenzeslaus knight and burgrave in Rosenberg and Lord Dýtmars knight called Kusner, Lord Henry and his brother Smýlon of Clum; likewise Lord John burgrave in Poresink and his brother Phýlipp, as well as in the presence of many other trustworthy men, voluntarily and liberately resigned the aforesaid goods. To the testimony of which thing we hand over to the abbot and convent of the aforesaid monastery this authentic document strengthened by the seal of our seal. Done and given in the year of the Lord 1305, on the day of the purification of the blessed Virgin Mary glorious.
